title: Xdrip noice/smoothing issue
body:
Hello, im running xdrip+ whit g6 native alghritm.. Last couple of days the noicereduction is totally gone, only getting like raw values going up and down and the charts looking like a battlefield sooo much noooicee.. 

Never happened before, i updated xdrip reseted settings, started a new sensor same thing.. Recisstance is high on the transmitter if that have something to do whit it? 1060. Only had it for 40 days... Running a patched zenwatch 3 aswel the readings look ok on that.. Trend arrows for delta updates dosent work on the watch tho..

Anyone have ideas how to get rid of the noice and get the smooth line back? 

Oh and also, the trendarrow during warmup is also gone..

And hey dont mind my bloodsugar had a rough wknd 😁

comments.body: Are you able to post a screenshot so I can see what you mean?

> Are you able to post a screenshot so I can see what you mean?
 @jamorham  here is what i mean, readings jumping all over the place been goin on for a week now. Also the trendarrow that shows during the 2h warmup time is totally gone. Also trendarrows dosent match in phone notification and inside xdrip+ sometimes, never happened before.

Been using xdrip for 2 years soon never had wonky problems like this before.

As for the watch, its patched and in demigod. Trendarrow dosent match the delta wave, neither the phones trendarrows.. Watch work well in standalone mode, only trouble is its nlt syncing back to phone when it comes in range sometimes, annoying and buggy but i can liv whit it :p Just want xdrip to work proper on the phone again.. Running nightly builds.
